ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to combat it.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What efforts are being made to combat it?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on an important issue. By following the money and examining public records, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that can help us understand the scope of the problem.
